title: fix(objectql): platformSystemApi on the api ObjectRepository.execute hands the dispatched action keeps the 'action' mark
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao6bxiPKCvVuzoFTExumbxoz)_
Fixes #35434
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；宿主代码里一个动作再去调用另一个动作时，被调用的动作若把自己拿到的接口交给「平台自用系统接口」函数，拿回的接口仍带动作标记，改成员、岗位、权限集分配、邀请会像权限文档写的那样被拒。
- 为什么做：补上上一轮「动作处理器保留动作标记」修复在文档里注明「不覆盖」的那条路，让权限文档对动作的承诺在动作链式调用时也成立。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是某个宿主动作经动作链调用、再经此函数写身份分配对象时被拒；仓库里目前没有这样的调用方，审计写入路径不变，回滚本次合并即可撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Route B of the card (an origin flag set by `execute` and copied by `derive`, held in a facet module, never in `engine.ts`).

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-object-repository.ts`: a module-local `WeakSet` keyed by `ScopedContext` instance, the dispatched action's origin flag, with `markDispatchedActionApi` / `isDispatchedActionApi`. `ObjectRepositoryFacet.execute` flags the api it hands the dispatched action. Neither helper is re-exported from either package entry.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-scoped-context.ts`: `derive` copies the flag to the child (so `sudo()`, `withRunAs(...)`, a transaction's context, the seeds' and `platformSystemApi`'s results keep it); `platformSystemApi`'s facet body answers a flagged api with that api's own `sudo()`, as it already does for an app-authored api. Mark and `flowRunId` are kept.
- `packages/objectql/src/platform-system-api.ts` header and row 1b of `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`: the "not covered" clause is dropped, nothing else in that prose.
- `engine.ts` is not touched, so the `check:facade-delegation-only` ceiling (ruling 6897467376) is unchanged. No published signature changes: `ObjectRepository`'s constructor is exported from both entries, so route A (threading the calling api into it) would have changed a published signature; it would also not have kept the mark on the reach path, because runtime's action-door layer passes repositories through unchanged and objectql only ever sees the inner `ScopedContext`, which carries neither flag.
- The flag is not the app-authored flag: the dispatched handler's permanent delete (ADR-0148 D3) still runs. The audit writer's hook api (`buildHookApi`, a fresh `ScopedContext`, never derived from a flagged api) is unchanged: `platformSystemApi` still takes the mark off there.

## Tests

New `packages/runtime/src/execute-dispatched-action-platform-system-api-35434.integration.test.ts` (real `ObjectQL`, SQL driver, real `SecurityPlugin`):

- dispatched from the action door's api (`buildActionApi`, an action handler chaining another) and from a bare engine api: an insert into each of the four identity-assignment objects through `platformSystemApi(ctx.api)`, `platformSystemApi(ctx.api.sudo())` and `platformSystemApi(trx)` is refused `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403 naming an action body, and nothing lands; the handler's own `sudo()` as a control;
- its insert into an ordinary object is owner-stamped with the caller;
- CONTROL: a hook registered in code, fired by the dispatched handler's write, still takes the mark off and its platform write lands;
- CONTROL: the dispatched handler's permanent delete still runs.

<details><summary>Red before the fix, green after, two ablations</summary>

- Before the fix (head a7af7193): `Tests 9 failed | 2 passed (11)`, each failure `insert on OBJECT through direct was not refused` (OBJECT per case) and the owner stamp `owner_id: null`. Premise held.
- After (head 532c6f3de, merged with main): `Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 21 passed (21)` (this file plus `action-door-platform-system-api.integration.test.ts`).
- Ablation 1, `execute` stops flagging (`api: new ScopedContext(executionContext, this.engine),`): `ablation-replace` landed (anchor 1 -> 0), objectql rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in 4 built files; `Tests 9 failed | 2 passed (11)`. Restore: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, `--absent` clean, `Tests 11 passed (11)`.
- Ablation 2, `derive` stops copying the flag: landed, present in 4 built files; `Tests 8 failed | 3 passed (11)` (the `sudo()` and transaction routes red, the direct route and controls green). Restore: blob == HEAD, `--absent` clean, `Tests 11 passed (11)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Package suites</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` at 532c6f3de: `Test Files 616 passed (616) · Tests 13907 passed (13907)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0; `check:test-typecheck: OK` on both.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The claim's file surface lists `engine-scoped-context.ts` "only if route A needs it". Route B needs it too: `derive` and the `platformSystemApi` facet body live there. #35541, the open PR that touched it at claim time, has since merged; `overlap-check` answered clean.
- The pending changeset `.changeset/35174-action-api-platform-system-api-mark.md` (unreleased) said the `execute` path is not covered. It is edited here as a seat amendment (its "Not covered" bullet is dropped); see DELIBERATE CORRECTION below.
- The two enumerations kept in the header ("two of the apis") and in row 1b name the app-authored hook api and the action door's api; per the card's fence only the "not covered" clause was dropped, and the third api is documented at the flag (`engine-object-repository.ts`).

## Verification

Read first, by risk: `packages/objectql/src/engine-scoped-context.ts` (`derive`, `platformSystemApi`), then `engine-object-repository.ts` (`execute`).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/execute-dispatched-action-platform-system-api-35434.integration.test.ts` after building objectql, expect `Tests 11 passed (11)`.

## DELIBERATE CORRECTION

DELIBERATE CORRECTION: `.changeset/35174-action-api-platform-system-api-mark.md` (pending, from #35174 / PR #35383) drops one bullet, which this PR makes false:

> - Not covered: the api `ctx.api.object(o).execute(name)` hands the action it dispatches is built by the engine, not the action door, so `platformSystemApi` still takes the mark off there.

After: the bullet is removed; no other sentence of that note changed. This PR closes that path. The `check-empty-changeset` red is by design for this class; the seat confirms the correction by its same-head at-tier contract-review record (landing-operations.md), not by a maintainer wait.
